module mg_07533(in, out);
input wire[4: 0] in; 
  output wire[5: 0] out; 
  reg[3: 0] lsb; 
  reg[1: 0] msb; 
  integer i; 
  always @(in) begin 
  msb = 2'b00; 
  lsb = 4'b0000; 
  for(i = 4; i >= 0; i = i - 1) begin 
  if(lsb >= 5) begin 
  lsb = lsb + 3; 
  end 
  msb = msb << 1; 
  msb[0] = lsb[3]; 
  lsb = lsb << 1; 
  lsb[0] = in[i]; 
  end 
  end 
  assign out = {msb, lsb}; 
 endmodule
